title: Switching Things Up
body:
Light-switch and gizmo work has produced two wall-switch variants.

Sound is included—unmute the video to hear the clicks.

[video: A ten-second in-engine comparison of center-pivot and one-sided wall-switch variants, with their shared positional clack audio.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-18-switching-things-up/wall-switch-variant-comparison-with-audio.mp4)
